sections.title: The same pattern, a bigger job
sections.content: You already know -tól/-től ... -ig for clock time — kilenctől ötig, "from nine to five", back in Unit 1. The exact same pattern works for anything with a starting point: a day, a month, even "from now on". Nothing new about the suffix itself, just new things to attach it to.

items.english: From now on I speak Hungarian.

sections.content: Same back/front vowel rule you already use everywhere else for -tól/-től — this lesson is about widening where you use it, not learning it from scratch.
